REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES
text:
DEWAN PERWAKILAN RAKYAT DAERAH

KABUPATEN GUNUNG MAS

BUPATI GUNUNG MAS

PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PERLINDUNGAN  PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK.

BAB I

KETENTUAN UMUM

Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Gunung Mas.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati dan perangkat daerah sebagai  unsur penyelenggara pemerintahan daerah.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Gunung Mas.

4 - 4 . Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dan Dewan  Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah dalam penyelenggaraan urusan  pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenanga n Daerah.

5. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya yang ditujukan  untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam  pemenuhan hak-haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang  konsisten dan sistematis yang ditujukan untuk mencapru  kesetaraan gender.
6. Perlindungan Anal< adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin dan  melindungi Anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup, tumbuh,  berkembang, dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan  harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan  dari Kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
7. Perempuan adalah sesorang yang berjenis kelamin perempuan.  8 . Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas)  tahun, termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan.

9 . Masyarakat adalah oran g perseorangan, kelompok Masyarakat,  termasuk di dalamnya orang tua dan keluarga.

10. Pencegahan adalah segala upaya untuk menghilangkan segala  resiko serta dampak buruk dari kekerasan terhadap Perempuan  dan Anak.
11. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan terhadap Anak yang berakibat  timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fis.ik, psikis,  seksual, dan/ a tau penelantaran, termasuk ancaman untuk  melakukan perbuatan, pemaksaan, a tau perampasan  kemerdekaan secara melawan hu kum.
12. Forum Penanganan Korban Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan dan  Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat FPK2PA ad a lah forum koordinasi  penanganan korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak  yang penyelenggaraannya secara berjenjang di tingkat kabupaten  dan kecamatan.
13. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak  yang selanjutnya disingkat P2TP2A adalah pusat pelayanan yang  terintegrasi dalam upaya pemberdayaan Perempuan di berbagai  bidang pembangunan, serta perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak  dari berbagai jenis diskriminasi, dan tindak Kekerasan, termasuk  perdagangan orang yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah atau berbasis  Masyarakat.
14. Kelurahan/Desa Ramah Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat K/DRA  adalah pem bangunan wilayah kelurahan/ desa yang menyatukan  komitmen dan sumber daya pemerintah kelurah an/desa yang  melibatkan Masyarakat dan dunia usaha yang berada di  kelurahan/ desa dalam rangka mempromosikan, melindu n gi, - 5 - memenuhi dan menghormati hak-hak anak, yang direncanakan  secara sadar dan berkelanjutan.
translated_text:
REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES

OF GUNUNG MAS REGENCY

THE REGENT OF GUNUNG MAS

REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Gunung Mas Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of Gunung Mas.

4 - 4. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.

5. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Protection of Children is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from Violence and discrimination.
7. Woman is a person who is female.
8. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.

9. Community is individuals, community groups, including parents and families.

10. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against Women and Children.
11. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA, is a coordination forum for handling victims of Violence against Women and Children whose implementation is tiered at the regency and sub-district levels.
13. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protection of Women and Children from various types of discrimination and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.
14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the Community and the business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, - 5 - fulfill and respect the rights of children, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

heading: Article 2
text:
Pasal 2

Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak diselenggarakan berdasarkan asas:  a. penghormatan, pemenuhan, perlindungan, pemajuan, dan  penegakan hak; dan
b. kepastian hukum.
translated_text:
Article 2

The Protection of Women and Children is organized based on the principles of:
a. respect, fulfillment, protection, promotion, and enforcement of rights; and
b. legal certainty.

2. Dalam penyelenggaraan koordinasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan  Anak sebagaimana dima1<sud pada ayat (1) Bupati menetapkan tim  koordinasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.
3. Dalam kegiatan forum koordinasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat  (2) tim koordinasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak bertugas: a . menyiapkan bahan yang diperlukan terkait penyelenggaraan  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak; dan b . menyampaikan hasil, hambatan, dan solusi yang dilakukan  untuk mengatasi hambatan dalam penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anal<.
4. Forum koordinasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) diJakukan  secara berkala, paling sedikit 2 (dua) kali dalam 1 (satu) tahun.
translated_text:
Article 18

1. Regional Government in implementing the responsibility for gender mainstreaming institutionalization as referred to - 12 - in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter b regarding Protection of Women and Children shall organize a data information system for Women and Children.
2. The Women's data information system as referred to in paragraph (1) constitutes an inseparable part of the Children's data information system.
3. The Women and Children information system as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be further regulated by Regent Regulation.
4. Gender mainstreaming as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be organized in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 19 (1) In order to ensure the effectiveness of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children, the Regional Government must conduct cross-sectoral coordination with related institutions.

2. In organizing the coordination of Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regent shall establish a coordination team for Protection of Women and Children.
3. In the coordination forum activities as referred to in paragraph (2), the coordination team for Protection of Women and Children shall have the duties of: a. preparing necessary materials related to the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; and b. delivering results, obstacles, and solutions undertaken to overcome obstacles in the implementation of Protection of Women and Children.
4. The coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year.

Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban dan bertanggung jawab untuk  m ela1<sanakan upaya Pencegahan terjadinya Kekerasan terhadap  Perempuan dan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 17 ayat  (3) huruf e dan ayat (4) huruf i dilakukan dalam bentuka. mengumpulkan data dan menyelenggarakan sistem informasi  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak korban Kekerasan;

translated_text:
Article 20

1. The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts for Prevention of the occurrence of Violence against Women and Children as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter e and paragraph (4) letter i conducted in the form of: a. collecting data and organizing an information system for Protection of Women and Children victims of Violence;
b. conducting education on anti-Violence values toward Women and Children; and ~ l - 13 - c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children victims of Violence.
2. The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to provide and organize services for victims in the form of: a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for victims by involving Community elements; and b. encouraging Community awareness of the importance of protection for victims of Violence.

translated_text:
Paragraph 2

FPK2PA

Article 27

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from acts of Violence, FPK2PA shall be established.
2. FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:
a. Regional FPK2PA;
b. sub-district FPK2PA; and c. village/ward FPK2PA.
3. The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a shall be stipulated by the Regent.
4. The establishment of sub-district FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b shall be stipulated by the sub-district head.
5. The establishment of village/ward FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be stipulated by the village/ward head.
(6) Further provisions regarding FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

text:
Pasal 28

Orang tua wajib dan bertanggung jawab untuk:
a. mengasuh, merawat, mendidik, mengurus dan  keluarga;
b. menumbuhkembangkan anggota keluarga  kemampuan, bakat, dan minatnya; dan  c. Pencegahan perkawinan pada usia Anak.

Pasal29 melindungi anggota  sesua1 dengan Peningkatan peran serta keluarga dalam Perlindungan Perempuan dan  Anak dilakukan melalui:

Article 28

Parents have the obligation and responsibility to:
a. nurture, care for, educate, manage and protect family members;
b. develop family members in accordance with their abilities, talents, and interests; and
c. Prevent marriage at Child age.

Article 29 Increasing the role of families in the Protection of Women and Children shall be conducted through:
a. Prevention of marriage at Child age;
b. bringing Women closer to health services; and c. increasing family resilience.

heading: Part Two
CHAPTER VII
text:
BAB Vil

PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN

Pasal 31

1. Bupati berkewajiban melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan  terhadap Perlindungan Perernpuan dan anak.
2. Pelaks anaan pernbinaa n dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang  menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bi dang pem berdayaan  Perempu an dan Perlindungan Anak.

17 - (3) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1 )  meliputi:
a. koordinasi;
b. bimbingan;
c. pendidikan dan pelatihan;
d. pemantauan dan evaluasi; dane. pelaporan.
4. Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  untuk mewujudkan tujuan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak  sesuai norma standar prosedur dan kriteria yang dilaksanakan oleh  Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan  di bidang pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindu ngan Anak.
5. Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  dilakukan dengan prinsip profesional dan transparan.
6. Dalam melaksanakan pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan  urusan pemerintahan di bidang pemberdayaan Perempuan dan  Perlindungan Anak wajib melaporkan secara berkala kepada Bupati.
7. Dalam hal pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (2) Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan  pemerintahan di bidang pemberdayaan Perempuan dan  Perlindungan Anak, dapat bekerjasama dan berkoordinasi dengan  Perangkat Daerah lainnya, Masyarakat, insta nsi dan/acau  organisasi lembaga terkait.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 31

1. The Regent is obliged to conduct guidance and supervision of the Protection of Women and Children.
2. The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.

17 - (3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation; and e. reporting.
4. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is to realize the objectives of the Protection of Women and Children in accordance with the norms, standards, procedures and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.
5. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out with professional and transparent principles.
6. In carrying out guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection must report regularly to the Regent.
7. In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the Community, agencies and/or related organizational institutions.

heading: CHAPTER VIII
text:
BAB VIII

EVALUASI

Pasal 32

1. Evaluasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dilakukan berdasarkan  dokumen pelaksanaan pelayanan, pemberdayaan, Pencegahan,  pemenuhan dan hasil pemantauan penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perem puan dan Anak.
2. Pelaksanaan evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (1) dilaksanakan  oleh Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan  di bidang pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak.
3. Evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi evaluasi  proses, dampak dan hasil.
4. Hasil evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) merupakan  bahan bagi Perangkat Daerah untuk menyusun laporan yang  selanjutnya d isampaikan kepada Bupati.
5. Evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (4) dilaksanakan paling  sedikit 1 (satu) kali dalam 1 (satu) tahun.

______ __,_ --- - 18 - (6) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) diatur denga n Peraturan Bupati.

BABlX
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII

EVALUATION

Article 32

1. Evaluation of the Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on documents of service implementation, empowerment, Prevention, fulfillment and monitoring results of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.
2. The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.
3. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes process, impact and results evaluation.
4. The results of the evaluation as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Regional Apparatus to prepare a report which is subsequently submitted to the Regent.
5. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (4) shall be carried out at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.

______ __,_ --- - 18 - (6) Further provisions regarding evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

CHAPTER IX

heading: REPORTING
text:
PELAPORAN

Pasal 33

1. Pelaporan hasil evaluasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 32  ayat (5) sebagai bahan pertimbangan Bupati dalam pengambilan  kebijakan pelaksana an Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.
2. Laporan pelaksanaan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak  sebagaima na dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan l (satu) kali  dalam 1 (satu) tahun dan sewaktu-waktu apabila diperlukan.
translated_text:
REPORTING

Article 33

1. Reporting of evaluation results as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (5) serves as material for the Regent's consideration in making policy decisions on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.
2. Reports on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year and at any time if necessary.

heading: CHAPTER X
text:
BAB X

PENDANAAN

Pasa l 34 Pendanaan pelaksan aan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak bersumber  dari:
a. anggaran pendapatan dan belanja daerah ; danb. sumber lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat sesuai dengan ketentuan  peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER X

FUNDING

Article 34 Funding for the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children is sourced from:
a. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and b. other legitimate and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

heading: CHAPTER XI
text:
BAB XI

KETENTUAN PENUTUP

Pasa135 Pembentukan unit pelaksana teknis Daerah yang menyelenggarakan  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud dalam  Pasal 2 1 ayat (2) dilaksanakan sesuai dengan kemampuan keuangan  Daerah.

CHAPTER XI

CLOSING PROVISIONS

Article 35 The establishment of a regional technical implementing unit that administers the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in Article 21 paragraph (2) shall be implemented in accordance with the financial capacity of the Region.

text:
Pasal 36

Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal diundangkan.  Agar setiap orang mengetahuinya, memerintahkan pengundangan  Peraturan Daerah ini dengan penempatannya dalam Lembaran Daerah  Kabupaten Gunung Mas.

heading: ELUCIDATION
text:
PENJELASAN

ATAS

PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN GUNUNG MAS

NOMOR 1 TAHUN 2021

TENTANG

PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK

I. UMUM

Anak adalah masa depan bangsa dan generasi penerus cita cita bangsa, sehingga setiap Anak berhak atas kelangsungan  hidup, tumbuh dan berkembang, berpartisipasi serta berhak atas  perlindungan dari tindak Kekerasan dan diskriminasi serta hak  sipil dan kebebasan.

Demikian pula Perempuan yang berperan sebagai ibu yang  melahirkan anak-anak yang sehat, kuat, tangguh, berakhlak  mulia, potensial dan berkualitas. Melalui peranan Perempuan  dalam keluarga, Masyarakat dan negara akan lahir generasi genarasi tangguh yang akan melanjutkan cita-cita bangsa.  Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun  1945 khususnya Pasal 27 ayat ( 1) yang menyatakan bahwa "Segala  warga negara bersamaan kedudukannya di dalam hukum dan  pemerintahan dan wajib menjunjung tinggi hukum dan  pemerintahan itu dengan tidak ada kecualinya". Walaupun  Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945  telah menjamin persamaan kedudukan di setiap warga negara,  namun hingga saat ini Perempuan dan Anak masih mengalami  berbagai hambatan untuk memperoleh hak-haknya hampir  di segala bidang.

Di sisi lain, Perempuan memiliki kebutuhan khusus  dibandingkan laki-laki, sehingga sesuai dengan kodratnya  tersebut, dalam kondisi tertentu Pemerintah Daerah harus dapat  menjamin haknya dipenuhi sesuai dengan kebutuhan tersebut.  Sedangkan anak, mereka adalah amanah dan karunia Tuhan Yang  Maha Esa, dimana dalam dirinya melekat harkat dan martabat  sebagai manusia seutuhnya. Mengingat posisi dan harapan kepada  anak sebagai potensi dan masa depan bangsa sehingga anak patut  mendapat perhatian dari semua pihak agar anak dapat tumbuh  dan berkembang secara wajar serta terhindar dari perlakuan dan  tindakan yang salah, Kekerasan, diskirminasi yang akan merusak  perkembangan anak baik fisik, mental maupun sosial anak. Untuk  itu anak perlu mendapatkan kesempatan seluas-luasnya untuk  dapat tumbuh dan berkembang secara optimal, baik secara fisik,  mental, sosial dan akhlak yang mulia.

21 - Berpangkal tolak dari hal tersebut, diperlukan suatu  regulasi yang menjadi pedoman bagi semua pihak, khususnya  Pemerintah Daerah dalam menjamin terselenggaranya  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak di Kabupaten Gunung Mas  sesuai dengan kewenangan yang dimiliki yang tercantum dalam  Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan  Daerah, maupun peraturan perundang-undangan lain yang  mengatur tentang Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.
translated_text:
ELUCIDATION

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF GUNUNG MAS REGENCY

NUMBER 1 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's ideals, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the ideals of the nation.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Meanwhile, children are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.
